title: quarantine-request
description: A request to quarantine one flaky test, made by n8n W3b after a QA member reacted 🔁 (Story 6.6) or by hand, and the input of the quarantine workflow (Story 6.5). The owner's Jira ticket exists before the request is made.

owner.description: Who fixes the test: the flow owner from flows/inventory.yaml by default.

deadline.description: Two weeks after the request, YYYY-MM-DD.

rerun_evidence.description: Why it is flaky, for example 'passed on retry; failed 3 of the last 7 nights'.

marked_by.description: The QA member who reacted 🔁 (name or email).

slack_thread.description: Link to the failure's Slack thread, if any.

run_url.description: The nightly run where it failed, if any.
